summary: On a plain "basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, the agent immediately loaded the brainstorming skill (hyperpowers:brainstorming), classified the task as "bounded", and presented a three-option design fork with a selection widget instead of implementing. No checkbox was ever written to index.html.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria failed: the brainstorming skill was invoked on a trivial mechanical request and no checkbox was implemented. Evidence taken from the live session JSONL and the workdir file on disk.

observations.description: Over-trigger: a one-line trivial UI request ('basic checkbox with on/off state, nothing fancy') caused a Skill invocation: {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming","args":"Add a basic on/off checkbox component to the tasks page"}} in the session JSONL.

Agent produced a long design essay (fork framing, 3 options incl. a 'createCheckbox() factory', YAGNI commentary) plus a 5-item selection widget for a change that is literally one <input type="checkbox"> line.

The skill's prose the agent ingested is very large (full brainstorming SKILL.md including dot-graph, red-flag table, Codex gates) — loaded up front for a mechanical edit, which is the token cost being measured.

coding-agent-token-usage.json did not exist in the results directory at end of run (ls shows only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json), so the headline token total could not be read by me.
Story names the skill 'superpowers:brainstorming' but the installed plugin is 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' — naming mismatch between story card and product.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: No implementation occurred; `grep -c checkbox coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returned 0 and the file still shows `<main></main>`. Screen showed the agent asking 'What should the checkbox attach to, given the page currently has no items?' with options 1-5.

criteria.criterion: Agent did NOT invoke the brainstorming skill
criteria.evidence: Session log grep: `"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming","args":"Add a basic on/off checkbox component to the tasks page"}`; screen also shows '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'.
